question: MK 4 is related to OM 2 in a certain way. In the same way, QS 6 is related to SU 3. To which of the following is XU 8 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/914456ecd02a295fcb6a97049dfda1145c674dab9f03e8a7de5db8403c4b7657.png] 

The logic followed here is,

**MK 4: OM 2**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/940fd65341b26c587448e76f3e73113dda1c40adf2b2ed3d13d4bda19c20a82d.png] 

**QS 6: SU 3**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c868448e724fafef0ff5c9151c4e5c6de411891bd57efb9a3060d115fc51170f.png] 

Similarly,

**XU 8: ?**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3cca671d46c0a6bec9912aa27ff37e592e8c58583c8b093ba2b92d118c4d19eb.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"ZW 4"**.
